question: What was the name of the bilateral Indo-French military drill held from 18 June to 1 July 2025 at Camp Larzac?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shakti 2025**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The bilateral military exercise named **Shakti 2025** was conducted between the **Indian Army** and the **French Army**.
 
• The exercise took place over a period of two weeks, starting from **18 June** and concluding on **1 July 2025**.
 
• The venue for this edition of the drill was **Camp Larzac**, which is a prominent military training facility located in **France**.
 
• The primary focus of **Exercise Shakti** is to enhance **interoperability** between the two armed forces and to share **combat experience** and **best practices** in the domain of **counter-terrorism** and **sub-conventional operations**.
 
• The drill involves high-intensity training, including **joint planning**, **tactical maneuvers**, and **neutralization of threat** scenarios, typically under a **United Nations** mandate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **History and Frequency**: **Exercise Shakti** is a **biennial** training event that alternates between **India** and **France**. The **first edition** of this exercise was held in **2011**.
 
• **Indo-French Defense Cooperation**: India and France share a deep **Strategic Partnership** established in **1998**. Defense cooperation is one of the strongest pillars of this relationship, involving **technology transfer**, **joint production**, and regular **military dialogues**.
 
• **Other Bilateral Exercises**:
 
 
• **Exercise Varuna**: A bilateral **Naval** exercise that highlights the maritime cooperation between the **Indian Navy** and the **French Navy**.
 
• **Exercise Garuda**: A bilateral **Air Force** exercise involving the **Indian Air Force (IAF)** and the **French Air and Space Force**.
 
• **Exercise Desert Knight**: A complex air exercise often involving multi-national participation but rooted in Indo-French cooperation.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Camp Larzac**: Located in **Southern France**, **Camp Larzac** provides a diverse and challenging **geographical terrain** suitable for simulating various operational environments, making it an ideal location for **infantry-based** drills.
 
• **Equipment and Participation**: During these exercises, both nations often deploy their latest military hardware. The **Indian Army** typically sends a contingent from one of its **Infantry Regiments** (such as the **Rajput Regiment** or **Gorkha Rifles**) to participate alongside French counterparts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Strategic Objectives**: The **Shakti 2025** exercise serves to strengthen the **diplomatic ties** between **New Delhi** and **Paris**, ensuring both nations can respond effectively to **global security challenges**.
 
• **Joint Operations**: Such exercises allow for the development of **Joint Command** structures, where officers from both countries work together to execute **mission-critical** tasks.
 
• **2024 Edition**: For context, the **7th edition** of **Exercise Shakti** was held in **May 2024** at the **Umroi Joint Training Node** in **Meghalaya, India**, showcasing the **alternating nature** of the hosting responsibilities.
